# AstryxSlider { #anylumino.AstryxSlider }

```python
AstryxSlider(value=0, *, label='', disabled=False, **props)
```

Render an Astryx slider control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default   |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value    | int \| float \| tuple\[int \| float, int \| float\] \| list\[int \| float\] | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `0`       |
| label    | str                                                                         | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `''`      |
| disabled | bool                                                                        | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `False`   |
| **props  | Any                                                                         | JSON-safe Slider props. Useful keys: min, max, step, orientation, valueDisplay, marks, minStepsBetweenThumbs, isOptional, isRequired, isLabelHidden, description, status, labelTooltip, className, and style. anylumino manages label, value, disabled state, and change synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Slider>. | `{}`      |
